title: SCE Sourcemap (wire schema v1)
description: Per-machine traceability sidecar written next to each emitted backend artifact as out/{language}/sce_sourcemap.json. Maps a mangled generated symbol back to its originating SCXML coordinates (file, state path, synthesised XPath, line range, IR-node kind). Authoritative producer is sce-build/src/forge/sourcemap.rs (struct Sourcemap); the runtime reverse-lookup tool sce-codegen addr2sce keys off this file. Byte-identical across all 6 backends for the same SCXML (symbols are BTreeMap-sorted). Consumers MUST ignore unknown fields: any purely additive change (a new optional field under symbols.*) is compatible with v1 and does NOT bump version. The stability status of this surface lives in this header alone, not in the payload — see docs/SCE_WIRE_CONTRACTS.md for the shared deprecation policy across SCE wire surfaces.

version.description: Sourcemap schema version. Always 1 for this revision. Additive field growth under symbols.* does NOT bump this.

source_hash.description: Hex-encoded sha256 of the generated source, byte-equal to the artifact's §6.2.6 drift header source hash.

template_hash.description: Hex-encoded sha256 of the codegen template set, byte-equal to the artifact's §6.2.6 drift header template hash.

symbols.description: Symbol table keyed by mangled symbol name (<machine>__<state_path>__<artifact>). BTreeMap-sorted for deterministic, cross-backend byte-identical output.

scxml_file.description: Author-facing path to the SCXML file the symbol traces back to. A name carrying the `__sce_synth_invoke__` infix denotes a document SCE synthesises in memory from an <invoke> element's inline <content>: it is not on disk, and line_range is relative to that synthesised document, not to the parent file that contains the inline element. A consumer resolving this path must handle that case instead of assuming every name opens.

scxml_state_path.description: Canonical state-hierarchy path (e.g. s1/s1p1). Empty for the per-machine symbol and for forge-kind body symbols.

scxml_xpath.description: Best-effort XPath approximation synthesised from the state path (e.g. //state[@id='s1']/transition[1]). Always non-empty; not guaranteed to round-trip against arbitrary source formatting.

line_range.description: [start, end] 1-based line range. end equals start when the source node spans a single line.

event.description: Event name for transition / raise / send symbols. Absent for state / on_entry / on_exit / machine / forge_body.

wcet_us.description: Worst-case execution-time hint in microseconds. Optional; absent unless a profiler consumer injects it.
